title: G-Contour: GPU Accelerated Contour Tracing For Large-Scale Layouts
problem: Contour tracing for VLSI layout processing and lithography simulation is computationally expensive on CPUs. Large layouts require significant processing time.
motivation: Accelerating contour tracing speeds up physical design and lithography simulation workflows, reducing design turnaround time.
method: GPU-accelerated contour tracing algorithm optimized for VLSI layout processing. Massively parallel implementation exploiting GPU throughput. Achieves 90× speedup over CPU implementation.
key_novelty: GPU-accelerated contour tracing with massive parallelism for large-scale VLSI layout processing.
limitations: Memory requirements and applicability to different layout formats and GPU architectures not discussed.
